text:
Ravi: Quick sync 10 we need a tight narrative for the benchmark launch focused on latency vs unit economics. Homepage hero + 1 blog + webinar. Minimal claims, clear test conditions.
Eve: For hero copy, short is better. Options: 'Fast responses. Lower cost.' or 'Keep latency. Cut spend.' Prefer first.
Priya: Agree on short. Also propose 1-line subcopy: 'Measured on mixed production traces; see appendix for methods.'
Mark: Chart set I'd push: 1) p99 latency barstack vs baseline (annotate client-side tail trimming), 2) tokens-per-dollar contour (sequence length x batch size). Keep both simple — no tiny text.
Eve: Can we add a small violin for latency distribution under the bar? shows shape without extra numbers.
Mark: Violin ok as inset. Main axes: ms on log scale for latency, tokens/$ linear.
Priya: Messaging ladder for blog: 1) problem: hidden latency / cost tradeoffs, 2) what we measure (p50/p90/p99, cost/1k tokens), 3) how we improve (routing, KV caching, quant profiles), 4) results & caveats.
Ravi: Webinar format: 25m demo (live instrumentation + route rules), 10m customer voice, 15m live Q/A. CTA -> gated whitepaper with appendix & CSVs.
Eve: Lead routing: use form field 'primary_pain' (latency|cost|security). Also add hidden utm parsing: example code -> `?utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_term=latency`
Priya: Growth rules: if primary_pain==cost OR utm_term==cost => tag=ECO; if latency=> SLA; if security=> SALES_PRIV. If trial_account && monthly_tokens>250000 => ping growth team.
design-bot: FYI uploaded two hero comps to /assets/bench/hero_v1.svg and /assets/bench/hero_v1.png. Colors: bg #0F1724, accent #00C3A7.
Mark: Nice. Need figure captions: include sample size (n=120k requests), window (7d), zero outliers trimmed 0.1%. Also add note: "baseline = public open-model runtimes run with default batching".
Ravi: Let's avoid naming competitors directly. Use 'typical open runtimes' phrasing.
Eve: Copy tests: I will draft 6 tweet-length lines and 4 LinkedIn intros. Will throw into content doc for A/B.
Priya: For transparency appendix we should include pseudocode for bench harness and the exact model flavors used (e.g., 7B fp16 -> 7B int8).
Ravi: Good. Also include a short FAQ bullet: "How do you measure cost per token?" with formula and links to CSV.
Mark: On charts, please export CSVs with columns: seq_len, batch_size, tokens_generated, total_cost_cents. Mark will add scripts to reproduce.
Eve: Webinar promo: 30s clip of latency CDF + narrator line 'See how routing cuts tail latency without raising unit cost' (we'll be careful with wording).
design-bot: Added promo MP4 + 3 thumbnails.
growth: I'll wire post-click params to SFDC: bench_launch mapping to campaign_2026_bench. Also added automation: interest=true for anyone downloading whitepaper.
Ravi: Next steps and owners: Eve = social copy + email subject tests; Mark = chart design + CSV exports; Priya = blog draft + appendix; design-bot = hero + promo assets; growth = lead routing + SFDC mapping. Check-in Thurs 9am PT.
Eve: I'll prioritize subject lines: A) 'How we saved on tokens (and kept latency)' B) 'Benchmark: cheaper inference, same snappy UX' C) 'Cut inference spend without breaking SLAs'
Priya: Reminder: keep any numeric claim framed (e.g., 'up to X' or 'in our tests'). Legal review will get final pass.
Ravi: Perfect. I'll collate everything in the launch brief doc and share link. Closing here until comps ready. :rocket:
